category.description: Configuration category (e.g. 'Audio'). Limits depend on op.

item.description: Configuration item (e.g. 'Volume'). Limits depend on op.

includeSecretValues.description: Return credential values (network password, FTP/Telnet passwords, Wi-Fi keys) in plain text. Default false: those values are replaced with ***.

value.description: Configuration value (string, number or boolean). Limits depend on op.

updates.description: Categories mapped to item/value pairs (primitive values only), for example {"Audio": {"Volume": 80}}.

additionalProperties.description: Item/value pairs of one category (primitive values only).

applyToFlash.description: When true, save the restored configuration to flash immediately (C64U/U64 and U2 only).

root.description: Directory to search for programs (not recursive; the firmware lookup returns one match per extension)

durationMs.description: Duration to run each program in milliseconds

maxPrograms.description: Maximum number of programs to run

outputPath.description: Output directory for run logs and captures

description:
Configuration operations.

Operations:
- list: List configuration categories reported by the firmware.
- get: Read a configuration category or specific item. Required: category. Optional: item, includeSecretValues.
- set [write]: Write a configuration value in the selected category. Required: category, item, value.
- batch_update [write]: Apply several configuration updates at once. Pass `updates` as {category: {item: value}}. Optional: updates.
- load_flash [c64u, u2] [destructive]: Load configuration from flash. Optional: category.
- save_flash [c64u, u2] [destructive]: Persist the configuration to flash. Optional: category.
- reset_defaults [c64u, u2] [destructive]: Reset configuration to factory defaults. Optional: category.
- read_debugreg [c64u]: Read the Ultimate debug register ($D7FF).
- write_debugreg [c64u] [destructive]: Write a hex value to the Ultimate debug register ($D7FF). Required: value.
- info: Retrieve Ultimate hardware information and status.
- version: Fetch firmware version details.
- snapshot [write]: Snapshot configuration to disk. Required: path.
- restore [write]: Restore configuration from a snapshot file. Writes only items that differ; a category the device refuses (e.g. 403 for a wrong network password) does not stop the others and is named in the error. Required: path. Optional: applyToFlash.
- diff: Compare configuration with a snapshot. Required: path.
- shuffle [c64u, u2] [write]: Run each PRG/CRT found, optionally capturing the screen. Optional: root, extensions, durationMs, captureScreen, maxPrograms, outputPath, resetDelayMs.
